--LINKMYROWDATA DECLARE @STOFCY VARCHAR(30)='{0}'; DECLARE @SDHDAT DATE='{2}'; DECLARE @USER VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_USER#'; DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) ='#LINKFUNC.GETLANX3#';
SELECT N'' 产品编码 ,'' AS 产品描述1 ,'' AS 产品描述2 ,ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PALNUM_0 + CTRNUM_0) FROM XWSPTHD WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 AND PRHFCY_0 = @STOFCY AND USERID_0 = @USER), 0) 数量 ,'' 单位 ,'' 库位 ,'' 批次 ,'' 计划号 ,'' 箱号 ,'' 采购订单 ,0 采购行 ,'' 托号 ,'' 箱单号 ,'' LINKROWID ,'G01' LINKAPPRROW ,'mui-hidden' LINKROWIDHIDL ,'' LINKROWIDHIDH ,'' LOTMGT ,'' LOTFLG ,'' SERFLG UNION ALL SELECT XWS.ITMREF_0 产品编码 ,ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS 产品描述1 ,ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0) AS 产品描述2 ,Cast(QTYSTU_0 AS REAL) 数量 ,XWS.STU_0 单位 ,XWS.LOC_0 库位 ,XWS.LOT_0 批次 ,XWS.PALNUM_0 计划号 ,XWS.CTRNUM_0 箱号 ,XWS.POHNUM_0 采购订单 ,XWS.POPLIN_0 采购行 ,XWS.XTXT_2 托号 ,XWS.CTRNUM_0 箱单号 ,XWS.PK_0 LINKROWID ,CASE WHEN XWS.POHNUM_0 = '' THEN 'D03' WHEN XWS.LOC_0 = '' THEN 'D03' ELSE '' END LINKAPPRROW ,'' LINKROWIDHIDL ,'mui-hidden' LINKROWIDHIDH ,CASE WHEN ITF.YLOTCAN_0<>2 AND ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0>1 THEN '*' ELSE '' END LOTMGT ,CASE WHEN ITM.LOTMGTCOD_0 > 1 AND ITF.YLOTCAN_0<>2 THEN N'lang:{zh:批次号管理,en:Batch Management,de:Chargenverwaltung}' ELSE '' END LOTFLG ,CASE WHEN SERMGTCOD_0 =3 THEN N'lang:{zh:序列号管理,en:Serial Number Management,de:Seriennummernverwaltung}' ELSE '' END SERFLG FROM XWSPTHD XWS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON XWS.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON XWS.ITMREF_0=ITF.ITMREF_0 AND ITF.STOFCY_0=@STOFCY WHERE XWS.PRHFCY_0 = @STOFCY AND XWS.USERID_0 = @USER AND XWS.RPFLG_0 <> 3 ORDER BY 采购订单 ,采购行 DESC ,产品编码
